text:
Ana: Heads-up — starting a quick finops sweep for Aceta (onboarding + renewal flags). High-level: embed-heavy usage last 7d, lots of short requests w/ cold-start cost. Want async updates before Friday QBR. Available data: billing export, per-route latency, prompt samples. Ping if you can shadow or own a piece. :eyes:

Mike: I can grab the per-route token breakout and run a 7/30 day trend. saw a 4x embed spike Thu 15:00 UTC. I'll post a small CSV snippet later.

Jess: drop the prompt set + 14d usage? I'll run a spend forecast and suggest throttles / caching knob changes.

Kai: I'll do token-econ sim (50/90/95th percentiles) but need model variants + quant config (fp16/4-bit). Also confirm whether Dedicated vs Hosted routing is in play.

cs-bot: [billing-alert] account aceta-prod hit 75% credits used at 1703456800 — threshold 80% scheduled. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/cost-ops :warning:

Ana: thx. here's a quick paste of current top routes and sample CLI to pull usage:

```json
{"route":"/embed","tokens_7d":195432,"calls_7d":842,"model":"open-embed-v1","quant":"q4_0"}
{"route":"/chat","tokens_7d":124321,"calls_7d":412,"model":"redwood-chat-2","quant":"fp16"}
```

CLI to fetch last 14d usage:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/aceta-prod/usage?range=14d" -o aceta_usage.json
```

Mike: posted breakout in thread. looking at 95th token per-call, caching could save ~28% on /embed if we enable prefix cache for recurring IDs. :robot_face:

Jess: I'll push a short-run playbook for throttles (soft cap + 429 handler) and an enablement note for their engineers to short-circuit cold starts.

Kai: will run sim and post CI numbers by EOD. If renewal is within 30d we should propose a reserved commit with a modest uplift to cover spike.

Ana: agreed — pls tag renewal team if forecast shows >30% uplift requirement. I'll compile a one-pager for QBR. :memo:

cs-bot: reminder scheduled: send qbr-packet-aceta at 1703458000
